connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package drainbrain-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
